description: This file defines a Swift class 'SessionManager' responsible for managing user session states, including authentication status, token persistence, refresh logic, and session clearing. It interacts with Keychain storage and the AuthAPI for login, logout, and token refresh operations.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: Manages user authentication session states, token storage, refresh logic, and session invalidation. It is an observable object suitable for use with SwiftUI.

methods.name: restoreFromKeychainIfPossible
methods.description: Restores session tokens from Keychain and updates authentication state. Attempts token refresh if access token is expired or missing.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, persists tokens, and updates session state.

methods.name: authorizedRequestToken
methods.description: Provides a valid access token, refreshing it if necessary, or throws if not authenticated.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by invalidating the session and clearing stored tokens.

methods.name: refreshIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes access tokens if expired or about to expire.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Updates internal token state with new tokens.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears session tokens from secure storage and memory.

methods.name: clearInMemory
methods.description: Resets in-memory token variables and authentication state.
